1. The petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. with a prayer to grant
anticipatory bail to him in case Fir No.1 dated 05.01.2024 under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
448, 120-B of Ipc, registered at Police Station Nri, District Sas Nagar, Mohali.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance of the order dated 14.02.2024 passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the petitioner has deposited a sum of Rs.50,000/- with the Registry of this Court and has joined the investigation.
The copy of the concerned receipt has already been taken on record.
3. Learned State counsel has submitted that the petitioner has joined the investigation and is no longer required for further investigation.
